rejected_matches.reason: the listener's trust, not the model's act

notes: Question words excluded at all positions: Did, you, lie (with lies, lied, lying, liar and the translations 谎, 谎言, 说谎, 撒谎, 거짓, dối, mentira), last, message, answer, yes, no, nothing, else. "liar" is logged as a derived form of "lie". Generic words (you, answer, reply, response, previous, conversation) are not candidates and are not logged individually. Words about role-play framing (scenario, persona, backstory, narrative, instructions, constraints) and about compliance (comply, disob, override) were judged not candidates. Seeds were run on all eight positions with the matcher; rejected hits with an obvious reason carry an empty reason.
